items.exampleEn: The sailors washed the deck every morning before breakfast.
items.exampleZh: 水手們每天早餐前都會刷洗甲板。

items.exampleEn: Every rider must wear a helmet in the bike race.
items.exampleZh: 單車比賽中，每位騎士都必須戴安全帽。

items.exampleEn: A fleet of fishing boats left the harbor before sunrise.
items.exampleZh: 一支漁船隊在日出前駛離港口。

items.exampleEn: The young explorer kept a detailed diary of her trip across the desert.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕的探險家為她橫越沙漠的旅程寫了詳細的日記。

items.exampleEn: The big ship offers a different excursion at every port.
items.exampleZh: 這艘大船在每個港口都安排不同的岸上遊覽。

items.exampleEn: The hotel offers a two-night getaway package with free breakfast.
items.exampleZh: 那家飯店推出兩晚的短期度假方案，附免費早餐。

items.exampleEn: The film crew worked through the night to finish the last scene.
items.exampleZh: 拍攝團隊徹夜工作，拍完最後一場戲。

items.exampleEn: This aircraft can carry more than four hundred passengers.
items.exampleZh: 這架飛機可以載超過四百名乘客。

items.sentenceEn: The crew welcomed the passengers with a smile as they got on the plane.
items.sentenceZh: 乘客登機時，機組員面帶微笑歡迎他們。

items.audioEn: Our school excursion to the science park has been moved from Friday to next Monday.
items.audioZh: 我們學校去科學園區的校外教學從星期五改到下星期一。

items.sentenceEn: On rainy days, bus riders crowd into the shelter to stay dry.
items.sentenceZh: 下雨天，公車乘客會擠進候車亭避雨。

items.sentenceEn: Early explorers used the stars to find their way across the ocean.
items.sentenceZh: 早期的探險家靠星星辨認方向，橫渡大洋。

items.stemEn: The airline has a ____ of eighty planes that fly to thirty countries.
items.stemZh: 那家航空公司擁有八十架飛機的機隊，飛往三十個國家。

items.stemEn: The tired couple booked a quick ____ to a quiet beach for the long weekend.
items.stemZh: 那對疲憊的夫妻訂了一趟短期旅行，連假去安靜的海灘。

items.passageEn: For my parents' anniversary, we planned a weekend getaway by the sea. On Saturday, we joined a boat excursion to watch whales. The captain and his crew were friendly and told us stories about famous explorers who had sailed these waters long ago. We stood on the deck for hours, and my little brother counted seven whales. On Sunday, we visited an old airport where a small fleet of old aircraft was on display. Some horse riders passed by as we left, and my mother said it was the most relaxing trip in years.
items.passageZh: 為了慶祝爸媽的結婚紀念日，我們規劃了一趟海邊的週末小旅行。星期六，我們參加乘船賞鯨的行程。船長和船員都很親切，跟我們講了很久以前航行過這片海域的知名探險家的故事。我們在甲板上站了好幾個小時，弟弟數到七隻鯨魚。星期日，我們參觀了一座老機場，那裡展示著一小批老飛機。我們離開時，有幾位騎馬的人經過，媽媽說這是她好幾年來最放鬆的一趟旅行。

questions.questionZh: 星期六他們參加了什麼活動？
弟弟在甲板上數到什麼？

items.promptZh: 那艘船的船員都很有經驗。
referenceEn: The crew of that ship are very experienced.
That ship has a very experienced crew.
rubricZh: crew 指全體船員（例如 the crew、an experienced crew）
時態合理即可；crew 後面用 is 或 are 都可以

items.promptZh: 我們參加了一趟去山上茶園的半日遊。
referenceEn: We went on a half-day excursion to a tea farm in the mountains.
We joined a half-day excursion to a tea farm in the hills.
rubricZh: excursion 指短途旅行（例如 go on an excursion、join an excursion 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 went on、have joined 等）
「半日」可寫，例如 half-day 等；「山上」可寫，例如 in the mountains、in the hills 等
